entries.title: A warmer welcome
entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic production-quality UI concept mockups for Footing's iPhone onboarding. A single coherent FLOW per image, shown as FIVE sequential app-content-only screens in one horizontal storyboard. This is one design direction, not multiple alternatives. Canvas requested 2560x1280. Each screen has natural 390x844 proportions, evenly spaced with clean thin separators, big enough for copy to read. NO phone frames, hardware, OS status bars, clocks, Dynamic Islands, home indicators, device shadows or browser chrome. Top margin title and tiny bottom design-review captions are outside the screen UI. Current date anchor October 20, 2026; avoid dates in the UI. State "Concept mockup · Example data" unobtrusively outside the frames.

Use Footing's current Daylight design system: ground #EEF1F6, white #FFFFFF grouped inputs, ink #0F172A, indigo #4F46E5, deep indigo #1E1B4B, lime #D9F99D with lime ink #1A2E05. Bricolage Grotesque strong headings, Figtree 15-16px body. Only the provided actual living-dot wordmark uses its existing Inter design, copy that source logo unchanged; do not typeset a new logo. New logo on welcome and small wordmark on subsequent screens. Use whitespace and group alignment before borders or cards. No nested cards, feature inventory, graphs or fake dashboards. Current source screenshot is reference for spacing and visual vocabulary; replace its old Pulse-led welcome, do not copy its old ring treatment. Product is Footing. Pulse is the AI coach. Cove is only a quiet supporting companion, NEVER the speaker or coach. No character speech bubbles, no mascot pointing at buttons. Buttons are 48px high with clear labels and readable text; clear Back and optional Skip for now. Keep long copy short but faithfully rendered. Common launch idea: the first usable app/welcome surface already carries the new logo; never a forced branded loading delay. Signed-in setup assumes account authentication already completed outside these frames. Adult eligibility must be resolved before health data collection. Mockups only, not a deployed app.

INVARIANT IDENTITY — DO NOT EDIT
Use the attached approved Cove board as the visual source of truth. Match the
selected approved view exactly. Cove is Footing's mature, grounded, slightly wry
emotional companion. Footing is the product/brand. Pulse is the intelligence and
coach represented by a separate faceless open ring. Cove accompanies, observes,
reacts and reassures; Cove does not coach, advise, speak or operate the product.
Preserve the warm-white compact rounded sculptural body and continuous head/torso,
existing visible support forms, grounded adult proportions, tiny navy oval eyes,
tiny restrained closed mouth, and soft matte premium 3D material. Preserve the
asymmetric broad swept crest, its rear attachment and curvature, indigo lower
base blending into pale lime at the upper tip. Match the reference's silhouette,
facial spacing, material, texture, light response and contact. Do not mirror.
Only supplied approved views determine anatomy; do not invent hidden features.
Pulse and Cove remain separate, with distinct silhouettes and clear space.

Rendered still design-review storyboard, 2560x1280 requested. Grounded wry/reassuring companion supporting at 10–25% of the welcome composition; only a small quiet companion on one later screen. Never use Cove as a progress meter or consent authority. Soft existing contact shadow on Daylight ground. Keep exact supplied logo distinct from the larger companion. plush/fabric texture, giant Pixar eyes, sclera, eyebrows, eyelashes, blush cheeks,

unless explicitly approved in a new canonical reference, teeth, tongue, huge grin,

WELCOME: Actual supplied wordmark near top; generous blank space; approved wry-front Cove about 160px. Headline "A little more footing." Body "Food, movement, and support that fit real life." Primary "Get started", tiny factual text "For adults 18 and over." This is usable immediately, no waiting for animation.
NAME: Back, progress caption "About you", small logo. Heading "What should we call you?" helper "Your first name is enough." Simple white input filled "Alex". Small Cove near bottom, not narrator. Button "Continue". This is the existing kind of single-question screen.
OPTIONAL CONTEXT: Back, eyebrow "Optional". Heading "What would you like help with?" Text box containing "Simple meals and keeping my strength." Helper "A sentence is enough. Nothing is sent to AI yet." Two quiet grouped rows "Allergies & intolerances" / "How you eat" with chevrons to existing preference questions. Button "Continue", secondary "Skip for now".

Underlined "AI sharing details & privacy". Primary "Allow Pulse", secondary "Continue without Pulse". Footer "AI food logging asks separately when you use it." This is a proposed in-flow entry to full disclosure, not blanket OS permissions.
READY: Heading "Your starting point." Existing target summary, simple two-row group "Protein floor 130g" / "Daily energy 2,000 kcal". Caption "Starting estimates. Edit any time." A small separate group "Your Pulse focus" and quoted sentence above, with product note "Save only if you want Pulse to keep this focus." Primary "Save focus & start", secondary "Start without saving focus". Approved quiet Cove near bottom. These are example targets, not measured clinical claims.
Board bottom note outside UI: "Same profile questions · Optional focus · Separate AI permission".

Title outside frames: "Start with what matters". Subtitle: "A short setup built around the person, before the numbers."
A substantively different simple onboarding flow: lead with chosen support focus, gather only the profile inputs needed for estimated targets, ask Pulse permission, then explicitly approve a saved focus. No chat simulation, no AI used during setup. Use exactly FIVE mobile content screens, left to right, each 390x844 natural proportions within requested 2560x1280 landscape storyboard. Flat indigo buttons, no purple gradients. NO Pulse rings or coach-avatar drawings anywhere; the coach can be named in text. Actual logo must keep its supplied living-dot mark. Approved Cove poses only on welcome and final confirmation. Different layout hierarchy from reference: left-aligned editorial headlines, big choices, extremely calm grouped form.
SCREEN WELCOME/FOCUS: actual logo, Cove quiet at modest size on upper right; title "What would feel easier?" One short line "Choose where you’d like support." Four simple selectable full-width rows: "Keep my strength" selected lime; "Make meals simpler"; "Find a steady routine"; "Something else". Small footer "For adults 18 and over." Bottom button "Continue". No weight-loss default.
SCREEN YOUR WORDS: Back, small brand. Title "Your goal, in your words." helper "What would you like Pulse to help you with?" Large text area containing "Keep meals simple and protect my muscle, especially when I’m busy." Small helper "A sentence is enough. Nothing goes to AI during setup." Primary "Continue", secondary "Skip for now". No keyboard shown. Clear optional label.
SCREEN BASICS: Title "Set a starting point." helper "A few details for estimated nutrition targets." Small labeled native fields, grouped with restrained spacing: "First name" Alex; paired "Age" 34 / "Sex for estimates" Female; paired "Height" 5 ft 8 in / "Weight" 180 lb; full-width "Activity" Some movement; "Weight direction" Maintain. An explanation link "Why these details?" and small line "You can change your targets later." Primary "Review my setup". This is an illustrative grouped form, not medical advice; retain readable body sizes.
SCREEN PERMISSION: Title "Choose Pulse’s help." Text "With your permission, Pulse sends your messages and relevant food, goal, health and preference context to Anthropic to write replies. Shot information is included only if you use tracking." Simple link "What is shared & privacy". Body "You can withdraw this in Profile." Primary "Allow Pulse"; secondary "Continue without Pulse". Tiny note "Food logging AI asks separately at first use." NOT a shared toggle or bundled consent.
SCREEN READY: Title "A starting point that’s yours." Show a quote on a quiet indigo-tinted area, "Keep meals simple and protect my muscle." Label "Your Pulse focus" and text "Save this focus so Pulse can use it from the beginning." Small two-line target review "Protein floor 130g" and "Daily energy 2,000 kcal". Action primary "Save focus & start"; secondary "Start without saving focus". Small approved encouraging Cove at the bottom-left away from controls. Saving focus is an explicit choice separate from permission; no prechecked memory toggle, no automatic promise that it is already saved.
Board footer outside frames: "Focus first → Your words → Basics → Permission → Ready". Include small design note "Optional food preferences, GLP-1 and Health connect after setup." Do not draw additional screens or add those as mandatory fields.

entries.title: Start with what matters — optional setup revision
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Revise the supplied "Start with what matters" storyboard, using the second supplied storyboard "Try one small thing" only as reference for the OPTIONAL SETUP ROWS on its fourth screen. Preserve the selected first storyboard's title, five-screen sequence, first four screens, current living-dot Footing wordmark, Daylight colors and typography, generous spacing, mature Cove identity and exact approved reference poses. This is a slight refinement of the selected flow, not a new direction.

CHANGE THE FIFTH SCREEN ONLY:
Keep heading "A starting point that’s yours." Keep the user's focus quote "Keep meals simple and protect my muscle." Keep explicit approval separate from AI permission.
Below the quote add a compact white grouped section with exactly these three tappable rows, separated by fine dividers, not three floating cards:
"Set nutrition targets" with smaller secondary "130g protein · 2,000 kcal" and a right chevron. This is review/edit of the estimates already set in setup, not another required task.
"Tell Pulse what matters" with smaller secondary "Review your focus" and a right chevron. This opens the current draft so it can be edited; it is NOT already permanently saved.
"Connect Apple Health" with smaller secondary "Optional · Connect when you’re ready" and a right chevron.
Section label "Make it yours" above the group. Do not use completion checkmarks that imply a draft focus is already saved or Health is already connected.
Keep a brief line "Your focus is saved only if you choose below."
Retain primary "Save focus & start" and secondary "Start without saving focus".
Reduce or omit the large Cove on this fifth screen to make room without crowding; Cove is already present on screen one. Do not place character art over text or buttons.
No duplicated targets card: replace the existing two-column protein/energy card with the three setup rows, incorporating its example targets as secondary text in the first row.
All five screens remain at natural 390x844 proportions in the existing wide storyboard. At least 15px body text in UI coordinates. Do not add any screens, mandatory tasks, rings, obsolete logos, confetti, chat bubbles, or new character poses. No OS status bars, device hardware or browser chrome.
Update the small subtitle outside the screens to "Focus first. Finish the rest when you’re ready." Preserve the other first-four-screen UI text.
Use the third input image, the current approved living-dot wordmark, as the sole product logo. Retired ring logos on the original Cove board are not product assets to use.
Character invariant: use attached original approved Cove board for identity, not its old branding.
